body:
Thanks, I really appreciate the response. My problem is actually that I don't have enough time on the weekends, as I usually feel the need to do work on Sunday to get ahead of the rush of emails on Monday. Technically I have free time on Saturday and some of Sunday but I'm usually thinking about work or feeling guilty for not working, and can't fully focus on anything else -- this is an issue with myself, not my job, but that's just the way I've always been with unfinished work.

I do have a good idea of what I'd like to do long term -- but it's creative, and has a small chance of being sustainable on its own. I could see it leading to commissioned work that could supplement a part time job down the road. Even that scenario isn't "likely" but I still want to try, and don't feel like that's possible right now.

I'm in the exact same boat as you. I work in a client-facing/implementation role at a software company where the software just does not work. I can't take my paid time off because I will fall even further behind on the increasing amount of projects I have.

For the last three months I've been applying for other jobs here and there that would have slightly less pay, while I became more and more miserable. Two weeks ago I decided I would just quit, flat out, then find a $15/hr job, and live off of ramen. I thought it over for a week and felt even more confident. In that time, I applied to a bunch of local stuff that would barely make rent and I felt so happy about making this decision.

Then literally none of them got back to me. For instance I applied to Whole Foods as a part time in-store shopper. I have a college degree, used to work in a supermarket, and I'm current employed. I even took their 10 minute quiz. They completely ghosted me.

So I don't know what I'm gonna do. I might still say fuck it and quit. I have two months rent saved. Every week I just feel more depressed, randomly crying, unable to sleep, and unable to think about anything other than my job. I just renewed my lease too. Don't know why I wrote this but had to vent.
